creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`docs/cli/agents.md` (lines 542-543) says `--asking`, and `cmd+shift+a`, go to "`blocked` first, then a program's notification, then `done`". `Attention::asking` sorts by `Alert` (`crates/muster-core/src/attention.rs:45`): blocked, stuck, message (a group with a message waiting for the human), notified, done. So the doc leaves out stuck panes and groups with a message, and an agent reading it would conclude that the chord never reaches a post to `@human`. Checked at 21601587.

Fix: list all five in that paragraph, in the enum's order, and say that a group's ask opens its conversation.
title: muster docs agents: the --asking order leaves out stuck panes and messages for the human
